title: Transport of a horizontal square-pasting equation through coherent comparisons
statement:
Let $A,B,C,D,E,F$ and their primed counterparts be categories with six functors $E_X:X\to X'$. Let $K:A\to B$, $L:B\to E$, $I:C\to D$, $J:D\to F$, $R:C\to A$, $P:D\to B$, $Q:F\to E$, $K_{12}:A\to E$, $I_{12}:C\to F$, with primed counterparts. Use the natural-transformation square notation of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], without requiring adjunctions. For functors $E_X:X\to X'$ and $F:X\to Y$ equipped with an invertible natural comparison $e_F:E_YF\simeq F'E_X$, put $e_{HF}=(H'e_F)\circ(e_HF)$ for a composite $HF$. For a cell $t:F\to H$ with the same endpoints, say it is respected if $e_H\circ E_Y(t)=(t'E_X)\circ e_F$. All compositions below are in the usual right-to-left order, with the canonical functor associators inserted. Choose the nine corresponding invertible comparisons. Let $c_K:LK\simeq K_{12}$ and $c_I:JI\simeq I_{12}$, and primed counterparts, satisfy $e_{K_{12}}\circ E_E(c_K)=(c'_KE_A)\circ e_{LK}$ and $e_{I_{12}}\circ E_F(c_I)=(c'_IE_C)\circ e_{JI}$. Let $a:PI\to KR$, $b:QJ\to LP$, $c:QI_{12}\to K_{12}R$ and primed counterparts be respected cells. If
$$ c'\circ(Q'c'_I)=(c'_KR')\circ(L'a')\circ(b'I'),$$
then for every $N\in C$,
$$ E_E\big((c\circ Qc_I)_N\big)=E_E\big(((c_KR)\circ(La)\circ(bI))_N\big).$$
The functors $E_X$ need not be faithful.
